acceptanceRule: Every criterion must PASS, Critical and High findings must be zero, the independent review must be APPROVED, the independent Red Team must pass over a VALID baseline control, and no blocker may remain. Otherwise M2 cannot pass.

criteria.acceptance: Local and public tag, HEAD, subject STATE, sealed commit and tree agree; the sealed subject is unchanged.
Unauthenticated public remote main and canonical tag resolve to the declared commit with no credentials or local object dependency.
The canonical chain validates and this later checkpoint anchors the sealed GATE-7 subject without rewriting it.
Current tooling validates every sealed Gate 4-7 predecessor detached at its exact public canonical tag.
The subject declaration reconstructs and validates exact size, digest, manifest, paths, checksums, mandatory content and secret cleanliness.
Two independent builds from public detached source are byte-identical and validate without workstation-only inputs.
The historical stale declaration is reproduced at its immutable tag, the corrective Gate 4 subject is proven, and final M2 transport has independently matching bytes/hashes.
Checklist/registry agreement yields exactly 105+50+51+48=254 distinct Gate 4-7 rows; none is removed or waived.
All 150 applicable lesson requirements are retained, specific and evidence-backed; no guarded recurrence is hidden.
All 404 accumulated rows and all 198 audit-checkpoint rows are complete with resolvable requirement-specific evidence.
Gate 4-7 architecture, ADRs, code boundaries and milestone consolidation agree; no structural decision is undocumented or contradicted.
Only Gate 4-7 capabilities are delivered; Gate 8 and later reservations remain enforced and no Gate 8 work starts.
One exact-subject invocation runs every mandatory stage in canonical order and exits 0; no partial rerun, stale artifact or PASS marker supersedes process termination.
Canonical counts are independently derived; every discovered mandatory test/guardrail executes and passes without double counting or caller-chosen exclusions.

criteria.criterion: Live dependency and secret security gates
criteria.acceptance: Every required advisory source is available and reports no blocking relevant Critical/High; current/historical secret scans pass without weakened rules.
Project detection, frozen policy/plan, sandbox runners, immutable evidence and pure verdict derivation execute for positive and failing projects without false PASS.
Project commands never run on host; scanner failure, marker ingress, legacy secret evidence, tampering and wrong-origin attacks fail closed before valid evidence/verdict.
Fresh isolated native CLI/editor installation resolves the installed entrypoint and proves authenticated approval, canonical workspace trust, durable recovery and cleanup.
No editor/CLI path bypasses API authentication, approval, sandbox, project/workspace binding, response authenticity or existing Gate 4 authority.
Fresh actual-stack capture persists governed lineage/rights and reads/lists/exports matching bytes through authenticated project-bound interfaces.
Consent, denied use, secrets/private ingress, corruption, replay, restart, retention, withdrawal, deletion and resurrection controls execute with unchanged sources.
Rights-qualified actual content is admitted, persistently indexed, retrieved with measured deterministic ranking and resolved exact citations through authenticated HTTP.
Storage-only laundering, traversal, secret/instruction ingress, cross-project access, corruption, stale citation, invalidation, retention, withdrawal and resurrection fail safely.
Gates 4-7 operate together while preserving Model Gateway, Agent Runtime, Sandbox, quality authority, approvals, experience rights and citation boundaries.
Real PostgreSQL schemas, migrations, reversibility, autogenerate, restart and recovery preserve inherited Gate data and enforce current constraints.
Absent/invalid/expired/replayed/forged authentication and post-response ambiguity are refused with bounded diagnostics and no unauthorized duplicate effect.
Every live test proves unique ownership, snapshots pre-existing identities, removes only owned resources, and leaves unrelated Docker/editor/application resources unchanged.
All inherited Gates 0-3 and prior Gate 4-7 mandatory stages remain present and pass under the exact subject.
Architecture, APIs, auth, operations, recovery, retention, rights, citations, limits and troubleshooting docs match observed behavior and have valid links.
Reusable artifacts carry truthful provenance/rights; production/user/provider data is not appropriated and trainingAllowed remains false absent explicit rights evidence.
Memory validates; every applicable guardrail resolves, is exercised with a valid premise/positive control, and has zero recurrence failure.
Every command record is the literal replayable invocation with exact arguments, runtime, directory, commit, inputs, terminal exit and sanitized outputs.
Subject internal review/Red Team is evidence only; this later session independently executes review, Red Team and functional proofs without self-promotion.
Fresh review of code, architecture, integration, security, maintainability, regressions and docs has zero unresolved Critical/High/blocker findings.
The full M2 attack battery executes against the exact subject over a VALID clean/null baseline with every mandatory attack defended and zero escape.
Every attack proves its marker/mutation is recognized by the actual public contract; a clean control passes through the same path.
All open audit findings and M2 risks are independently re-evaluated; every claimed correction holds and no blocking debt is mislabeled accepted.
A new unauthenticated public clone independently validates the subject and runs the complete verifier using only subject-versioned inputs plus explicitly documented private runtime configuration.
Final review package reconstructed independently from public source matches declaration byte-for-byte, twice, and every retained input/attempt is identified.
This later audit checkpoint passes its own Green Keeper, completeness, counts, inventory, secret, integrity and validation controls without altering the subject.
Commands, files, tests, quality, risks, findings, provenance, review, Red Team, limits and handoff are truthful, complete and resolvable.
Tool/provider/model and limits are recorded; fresh-session independence is not called cross-tool and unavailable cross-tool evidence is never invented.
An attestation is written only after all other criteria pass and names the immutable subject plus this later audit checkpoint; otherwise none exists.
Only all-green evidence may yield MILESTONE_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT_PASS; any blocker/failure yields truthful REWORK_REQUIRED/BLOCKED and never MILESTONE_EXTERNAL_PASS.
No Gate 8 code, checkpoint, authorization, status transition or work is created by this audit, regardless of outcome.
